lines.lyric_translation: Law of total madness
Grrr, my mind is a mess
I don’t care who they are

lines.lyric: Seo itteunji sanggwan anko jijeo bunhae
lines.lyric_hangul: 서 있든지 상관 않고 짖어 분해
lines.lyric_translation: I bark like an aggressive dog, I’m angry
Leaving behind anyone who doesn’t understand

lines.lyric: Nareul hyanghan shiseondeuri jodeun an jodeun
lines.lyric_hangul: 나를 향한 시선들이 좋든 안 좋든
lines.lyric_translation: Whether people view me in a good or bad light

lines.lyric: Da ttagabge neukkyeojigo dabdabham shimhan jigeum
lines.lyric_hangul: 다 따갑게 느껴지고 답답함이 심한 지금
lines.lyric_translation: It all feels uncomfortable, my frustration level is serious right now

lines.lyric: Gamjeong gibok sai na jashingwaye jeonjaeng jung
lines.lyric_hangul: 감정 기복 사이 나 자신과의 전쟁 중
lines.lyric_translation: In between mood swings, I’m at war with myself
Adult interference makes me even more restless
My current state, the way I talk, my actions

lines.lyric_hangul: 이러면 안 된단 걸 알아도 모두 반대가 돼
lines.lyric_translation: I know I shouldn’t be like this / But everything goes the opposite way

lines.lyric: I want you to understand me
lines.lyric_hangul: I want you to understand me
lines.lyric_translation: I want you to understand me
I don’t know what will happen
Again today, I’m barking
Don’t talk to me

lines.lyric: Nugul bwado jijeo mureotteudeo jjijeo jjijeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 누굴 봐도 짖어 물어뜯어 찢어 찢어
lines.lyric_translation: Whoever I see, I bark, I bite, I rip apart
Don’t talk to me
I’m frustrated, so frustrated
Don’t bump into me
After I bite, I’ll chew and gnaw
Don’t bump into me
Frustrated, frustrated, frustrated
Now I can’t even sleep

lines.lyric_hangul: 언제부터 푹신해야 할 베개가 쿠션 아닌
lines.lyric_translation: My pillow should be soft but instead of a cushion

lines.lyric_hangul: 책 더미가 됐는지 난 이 상황을 부셔 버릴
lines.lyric_translation: It’s a mountain of books / I want strength to break apart this situation

parts.lyric: Nan i sanghwangeul bushyeo beoril himeul weonhae

lines.lyric_hangul: 힘을 원해 수만 번의 푸쉬업도 소용없지
lines.lyric_translation: But thousands of push ups don’t help
I’m just going through some change

lines.lyric: Ihae mot haneun eoreundeure nunen yangachigo
lines.lyric_hangul: 이해 못 하는 어른들의 눈엔 양아치고
lines.lyric_translation: Adults who don’t understand think I’m a delinquent

lines.lyric: Nal pigonhage haneun geudeure shido ape moktane
lines.lyric_hangul: 날 피곤하게 하는 그들에 시도 앞에
lines.lyric_translation: They try but they tire me out

lines.lyric_hangul: 목타네 속타게 한 그들은 다 폭망해
lines.lyric_translation: I burn them up and eventually, they fail
My current state, the way I talk, my actions

lines.lyric_hangul: 이러면 안 된단 걸 알아도 모두 반대가 돼
lines.lyric_translation: I know I shouldn’t be like this / But everything goes the opposite way

lines.lyric: I want you to understand me
lines.lyric_hangul: I want you to understand me
lines.lyric_translation: I want you to understand me
I don’t know what will happen
Again today, I’m barking
Don’t talk to me

lines.lyric: Nugul bwado jijeo mureo tteudeo jjijeo jjijeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 누굴 봐도 짖어 물어뜯어 찢어 찢어
lines.lyric_translation: Whoever I see, I bark, I bite, I rip apart
Don’t talk to me
I’m frustrated, so frustrated
Don’t bump into me
After I bite, I’ll chew and gnaw
Don’t bump into me
Frustrated, frustrated, frustrated
We rolling, we rolling
Till I run out of breath
We growling, we growling
We’re turning into a monster again

lines.lyric_hangul: 난 답이 없는 문제처럼 내 화는 못 풀어
lines.lyric_translation: Like a question without an answer / I can’t get rid of my anger

lines.lyric_hangul: 내 정신은 정상이 아닌 걸 나도 알긴 알아도 다 참아줘
lines.lyric_translation: My mind is not normal / I know but take it easy on me
This time only comes once in life

lines.lyric_hangul: 내가 좀 짜증 내더라도 눈 한번 딱 감아줘
lines.lyric_translation: Even if I’m annoying / Just close your eyes on me once
How, how much more do I have to wander?
How, how much
A million kilometers
Oh my, oh my, what is this?
Oh my, oh my
Ten million kilometers
Answer me, you all answer me, it’s frustrating me, grrr
